name: hiddenConfounder.falseEdges
description: Hidden common cause z → x1, z → x2 (z not in the CSV): edges proposed that are not in the true graph (known limit: Nothing can tell a hidden common cause from a direct link using the observed columns alone; x1 and x2 truly share no edge, so any edge found between them is false.)

name: nearDeterministic.recall
description: Near-noiseless copy x1 → x2, x3(t) = x2(t) + 0.01 ε: share of the true edges found with their direction (known limit: The skeleton conditions on every other current and lagged column at once; x3 is an almost exact copy of x2 in the same row, so conditioned on it x2 has nothing left to correlate with x1 (the collider-bias limitation docs/causalInference.md describes). The copy itself, within one row, is outside the lag-1 model.)

name: odeChainDt0p1.recall
description: Linear ODE chain x1 → x2 → x3 → x4, sampled every 0.1 s: share of the true edges found with their direction (known limit: Sampled finely, each variable changes little in one row; conditioned on the source's current value, its previous one adds only about Δt/2 of the coupling, below the skeleton's fixed threshold of 0.1 in partial correlation. More rows do not help (6,000 rows give the same), since the threshold is on the size of the correlation, not its significance.)

name: odeChainDt2.equationError
